claims.claim_text: Traffic performance under adverse weather has been measured by average speed, travel time index, journey-time reliability, and composite resilience scores.

claims.mismatch_detail: The paper uses ONLY 'average car journey time' (median journey time across five Cambridge corridors) and traffic counts. It never mentions 'average speed', 'travel time index', 'journey-time reliability', or 'composite resilience scores'. All four metrics named in the claim are absent from the source.
claims.tier_reason: Preprint on SSRN (ssrn.com/abstract=4970168); not yet peer-reviewed at time of extraction. DARe/EPSRC-funded, University of Cambridge — credible but not Tier A until published in a peer-reviewed journal.
claims.doi_note: No DOI assigned; available at https://ssrn.com/abstract=4970168
claims.hallucination_detail: Source is real and locatable. The quote is verified via search_for. However, the four metrics attributed to it (average speed, travel time index, journey-time reliability, composite resilience scores) do not appear anywhere in the paper. This is a misattribution: the claim projects a metric framework onto a source that uses a different, simpler measure.
